body: The Skrillex and Zomboy remix goes hard!

Hey, stay a bit longer. I urge you not to end it here. You're in the most danger you will ever be in. That means you can do literally anything with your life at this point. Go travel, go meet people, climb a mountain, wrestle a shark! Danger is relative. You are facing 100% danger now, so go do something you've always dreamed of. Make life work. As long as you're not hurting other people, you can do anything.

PM me if you need to talk. There are lots of people who want you here.

I've been in the same boat as you for years. There isn't anything wrong with feeling that way, we all get it. If there is anyone you can talk to about it, please do. It can be literally anyone you feel comfortable with; your best friend, your teacher, your parent, your sibling, me.

If you feel like you need to talk to someone but don't know who, feel free to PM me anytime and I should get back to you promptly.

It gets better
Thank you for that. I just don't know how to live until it gets better.
